metadata.description: Agent skills for Lightcone Research — ASTRA authoring and validation.

plugins.name: astra
plugins.description: Reference for ASTRA 0.1 (astra.yaml) and its `astra` CLI: inputs tracked in git, outputs and their recipes, decisions and options, universes written in astra.yaml, declared analyses read by address, prior insights and findings with evidence and quote verification, how results stand against their records, and upgrading a 0.0.x spec. Invoke when reading, writing, validating, or debugging an astra.yaml spec, or when the user asks about ASTRA. Ships hooks that validate astra.yaml on save and orient agents at session start in an ASTRA project.

plugins.name: lightcone
plugins.description: Companion for working on a Lightcone project — an ASTRA 0.1 analysis (astra.yaml) executed with the `lc` CLI. Covers the project model (a uv project, direct or containerized, stored as a DataLad dataset), the development workflow (allocate a cluster with `lc compute`, probe with `lc run`, integrate recipes, commit, `lc materialize`), recipe resources and GPUs, status interpretation (ok/behind/stale/missing, unfetched) and failure diagnosis, sharing the project with `lc publish` and reading a clone's data with `lc fetch`, and how to engage the user at each phase: interview to scope a brand-new project, orient and summarize when resuming an existing one. Invoke whenever the user wants to start, resume, plan, run, debug, or discuss a Lightcone/ASTRA analysis project. Bundles the `astra` plugin (spec reference, validate-on-save & session-start hooks) — install `lightcone` alone to get the full stack.
